title: Army's 4ID backs 18-day drive to end violence against women

blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — The Army’s 4th Infantry Division (4ID) has thrown its support behind the nationwide 18-Day Campaign to End Violence Against Women (VAW), vowing to protect women and children both inside military camps and in conflict-affected communities. Troops marked the start of this year’s observance on Monday, Nov. 23, with a simultaneous flag-raising ceremony at the 4ID Administration Building in Camp Edilberto Evangelista, Barangay Patag, here. During the ceremony, Brig. Gen. Edmund Paul Delos Santos, commander of the 402nd Infantry Brigade, read the message of Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) Chief of Staff Gen.
